# A real tool server, from approval to answer: the program `mcpecho` is the test
# binary itself, started by Metagente as a child process.

env SECRET_CANARY=leak-me
env VISIBLE_ON_PURPOSE=shared

# nothing is started before the person approves it (T1)
! exec metagente run agent.ag say text=hello
stderr 'have not approved for this project'
stderr 'starts the program: mcpecho'
stderr 'metagente trust agent\.ag'

# approving is explicit, and the list is shown before anything is saved
exec metagente trust --yes agent.ag
stdout '\[NEW\] starts the program: mcpecho'
stdout 'Approved 1 item'

# now it answers
exec metagente run agent.ag say text=hello
stdout '^echo: hello$'

# the program sees only what the agent file named (E1)
exec metagente run agent.ag peek name=VISIBLE_ON_PURPOSE
stdout '^value: shared$'
exec metagente run agent.ag peek name=SECRET_CANARY
stdout '^value: $'
! stdout 'leak-me'

# approvals are listed, and can be taken back
exec metagente trust --list
stdout 'starts the program: mcpecho \(it receives the variables VISIBLE_ON_PURPOSE\)'
exec metagente trust --revoke
stdout 'Removed 1 approval'
! exec metagente run agent.ag say text=hello
stderr 'have not approved'

# approvals are never kept inside the project (T2)
env METAGENTE_CONFIG_DIR=$WORK/inside
! exec metagente trust --yes agent.ag
stderr 'inside the project'
! exists inside

-- agent.ag --
agent Echo
  goal "Send text back, or tell what the tool server can see"
  tool server from mcp "mcpecho" env "VISIBLE_ON_PURPOSE"
  accepts say text
  accepts peek name
  on say
    reply server.echo text: text
  on peek
    reply server.env name: name
